title: Erinn H NDE 6155
content: I was starting to have a panic attack, going in and out of consciousness. I felt I was going to faint and felt myself starting to fall backwards, also blacking out. When I completely blacked out is when I found myself below the ceiling. Then I saw two friends and myself that I was with. I saw myself with both my hands covering my face, and remembered that when I was in my body I was covering my face because of the feeling of blacking out. I was surrounded by darkness but did not feel at all that I was in the dark. I immediately felt peace. I no longer felt all my worries and fears, but they weren't taken completely. I had a knowing that they were placed to the right of me for the time being. Something telepathically told me to accept the peace I was feeling, that if I did I would have eternity, and eternity was straight ahead and that meant death to earthly life. If I said no then I wouldn't have the peace anymore. Knowing if I said ‘yes’ to the peace that I would die I said ‘no’, because the whole time I remember being really worried being out of my body and wanting to go back. However, the worry you feel outside your body is different - it doesn't come with fear and anxiety attached to it, like it would if you were in your body. As soon as I made the conscious decision to not accept the peace at the moment. I was then immediately back in my body. When I was back in my body I was still dealing with the panic attack, but because of the peace I had just felt I was able to fight through it and recover.

arrival.other_being_detail: Something telepathically told her to accept the peace; no visual description of the entity/presence.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE to ceiling, darkness/peace, telepathic offer/choice, immediate return to body.
